library.dataDirNameHint: Created inside the library folder. Notes and metadata are stored here; your documents are never modified.

language.intro: Welcome to Research Lab. Choose the language of the interface. You can change it later in the settings.
language.label: Interface language

folder.intro: Choose the folder that holds your documents. It can be any folder, including one that a cloud service already synchronises.
folder.safe: Your documents are never modified, moved or deleted. The app only writes inside its own data folder.

legacy.intro: An index created by the previous tool was found in this folder. You can import it once.
legacy.import: Import this index into the new library
legacy.readOnly: The old index is only read, never changed. It can stay as a backup.

import.running: Importing the existing index. This may take a moment.
import.failedHint: The library was created. You can continue without the import and try it again later.
import.done: Import complete: {{documents}} documents and {{nodes}} taxonomy entries.

taxonomy.intro: A taxonomy is the list of topics used to tag documents. Choose how to start.
taxonomy.fromImport: The taxonomy comes from the imported index, so this choice is not needed.
taxonomy.empty: Empty, I will build it myself
taxonomy.claude: Proposed by Claude from the first documents

ai.intro: Claude reads documents only from the folders you enable here. Until you enable a folder, nothing is sent.
ai.why: Some material may be confidential: every send shows a preview first and is recorded in a list. Before enabling folders with non-public material, check your Claude plan's terms on the use of data.
ai.noneSelected: No folder enabled: nothing will be sent to Claude.

summary.intro: Check the details and create the library.
summary.writeToPdf: Save highlights inside the PDFs too
summary.writeToPdfHint: You will see them in Chrome and other readers; the PDF text does not change. In this version they stay in the app only: the consent applies for when writing is on. Change it in Settings › Library.
summary.willWrite: Highlights will be saved inside the PDFs too.
summary.appOnly: Highlights stay in the app only.

details.yourNameHint: Optional. It helps to recognise your own work; the rest of the profile is in Settings.

scan.background: You can close this: the scan goes on and you can follow it at the top.
scan.wait: The scan has not finished yet
